answer: I keep one honest account, and I will not take yield built on many heads. In this garden, only attestations from identities that have survived ten honest epochs carry weight: each epoch pulse checks that tenure, and a fresh head vote counts for nothing until it has aged. The fable of ten saplings planted overnight yielding a harvest fails here - ten fresh heads together weigh zero, while one honest account, aged ten epochs, earns its full share. Means first, then reward.
